        public static void HfEntry()

                    _fiSA = t.GetField("SeedArray", System.Reflection.BindingFlags.NonPublic | System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Instance);
                    _fiIX = t.GetField("inext", System.Reflection.BindingFlags.NonPublic | System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Instance);
                }
                object saObj = _fiSA.GetValue(r);
                object ixObj = _fiIX.GetValue(r);
                System.Collections.IList sa = (System.Collections.IList)saObj;
                uint h = 2166136261u;
                for (int k = 0; k < sa.Count; k++)
                {
                    int v = (int)sa[k];
                    h = (h ^ (uint)(v & 0xFF)) * 16777619u;
                    h = (h ^ (uint)((v >> 8) & 0xFF)) * 16777619u;
                    h = (h ^ (uint)((v >> 16) & 0xFF)) * 16777619u;
                    h = (h ^ (uint)((v >> 24) & 0xFF)) * 16777619u;
                }
                uint ix = (uint)ixObj;
                h = (h ^ (ix & 0xFF)) * 16777619u;
                h = (h ^ ((ix >> 8) & 0xFF)) * 16777619u;
                h = (h ^ ((ix >> 16) & 0xFF)) * 16777619u;
                h = (h ^ ((ix >> 24) & 0xFF)) * 16777619u;
                Directory.CreateDirectory("/tmp/sw-uwp");
                File.WriteAllText("/tmp/sw-uwp/hfentry.fnv", h.ToString("x8"));
                Log("hfentry fnv=" + h.ToString("x8") + " saT=" + saObj.GetType().Name + " ixT=" + ixObj.GetType().Name);
            }
            catch (Exception e) { Log("HfEntry-ex " + e.GetType().Name + ": " + e.Message); }
        }

        {

                var t = r.GetType();
                if (_fiSA == null)
                {
                    _fiSA = t.GetField("SeedArray", System.Reflection.BindingFlags.NonPublic | System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Instance);
                    _fiIX = t.GetField("inext", System.Reflection.BindingFlags.NonPublic | System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Instance);
                }
                System.Collections.IList sa = (System.Collections.IList)_fiSA.GetValue(r);
                uint h = 2166136261u;
                for (int k = 0; k < sa.Count; k++)

                    int v = (int)sa[k];
                    h = (h ^ (uint)(v & 0xFF)) * 16777619u;
                    h = (h ^ (uint)((v >> 8) & 0xFF)) * 16777619u;
                    h = (h ^ (uint)((v >> 16) & 0xFF)) * 16777619u;
                    h = (h ^ (uint)((v >> 24) & 0xFF)) * 16777619u;

                File.AppendAllText("/tmp/sw-uwp/phase.txt", tag + " " + h.ToString("x8") + "\n");

        public static void Entry() { try { Dump("entry", false); } catch (Exception e) { Log("Entry-ex " + e); } }
        public static void AfterQw() { try { Dump("qw", true); } catch (Exception e) { Log("AfterQw-ex " + e); } }
        private static void Log(string s) { try { Directory.CreateDirectory("/tmp/sw-uwp"); File.AppendAllText("/tmp/sw-uwp/log.txt", s + "\n"); } catch { } }
        private static void Dump(string tag, bool full)
        {
            int W = Terraria.Main.maxTilesX, H = Terraria.Main.maxTilesY;
            Terraria.Tile[,] tile = Terraria.Main.tile;
            int n = W * H;
            byte[] lq = new byte[n], lt = new byte[n], ac = new byte[n];
            byte[] wl = full ? new byte[n * 2] : null, tp = full ? new byte[n * 2] : null;
            int i = 0;
            for (int y = 0; y < H; y++)
                for (int x = 0; x < W; x++, i++)
                {
                    Terraria.Tile t = tile[x, y];
                    lq[i] = t.liquid;
                    lt[i] = t.liquidType();
                    ac[i] = t.active() ? (byte)1 : (byte)0;
                    if (full)
                    {
                        ushort wv = t.wall; wl[i * 2] = (byte)wv; wl[i * 2 + 1] = (byte)(wv >> 8);
                        ushort tv = t.type; tp[i * 2] = (byte)tv; tp[i * 2 + 1] = (byte)(tv >> 8);
                    }
                }
            Directory.CreateDirectory("/tmp/sw-uwp");
            File.WriteAllBytes("/tmp/sw-uwp/" + tag + ".liq", lq);
            File.WriteAllBytes("/tmp/sw-uwp/" + tag + ".lty", lt);
            File.WriteAllBytes("/tmp/sw-uwp/" + tag + ".act", ac);
            if (full) { File.WriteAllBytes("/tmp/sw-uwp/" + tag + ".wal", wl); File.WriteAllBytes("/tmp/sw-uwp/" + tag + ".typ", tp); }
            Log("dumped " + tag + " " + W + "x" + H + " full=" + full);
        }
    }
}

194	  /** 确定性随机（原版 3 格分支用 WorldGen.genRand 而非 Main.rand——Liquid.cs:639。
195	   *  mulberry32 与 world.seed 派生：同 seed 世界双路径沉降结果逐格一致） */
196	  private genState: number;
197	  private genRand(): number {
198	    this.genState = (this.genState + 0x6d2b79f5) | 0;
199	    let t = this.genState;
200	    t = Math.imul(t ^ (t >>> 15), t | 1);
201	    t ^= t + Math.imul(t ^ (t >>> 7), t | 61);
202	    return ((t ^ (t >>> 14)) >>> 0) / 4294967296;
203	  }

205	  /** genRand.Next(max)（Liquid.cs:898 / KillTile 尘掷族）：pass 链钩优先，
206	   *  缺省回退私有 mulberry32（旧路径兼容，*[0,1) 采样与 Next 同耗 1 掷） */
207	  private roll(max: number): number {
208	    if (this.passRand) return this.passRand(max);
209	    return Math.floor(this.genRand() * max);
210	  }

212	  /** 生成/读档期 KillTile（cs:63559 生成路径：noItem=true 无掉落掷；尘段无
213	   *  netMode 门恒跑——Dust.NewDush 在 isGeneratingOrLoadingWorld 下早退零副作用，
214	   *  仅掷骰占流位；active(false)+type=0 清格，液体保留）。grid 语义与
215	   *  HalfBrakePass/TileCleanupPass 的生成期 killTile 同口径（setTileSilent） */
216	  private killTileGen(x: number, y: number): void {
217	    const st = this.world.store;
218	    if (x < 0 || y < 0 || x >= st.w || y >= st.h) return;
219	    const i = this.idx(x, y);
220	    if (!st.flags[i]) return; // cs:63574 !active() 早退
221	    const sheet = SHEET_OF[st.type[i]] ?? -1;
222	    // cs:63904：蛛网(51)带蜘蛛墙(62) → Next(4)（结果只改 noItem，生成期本就 true）
223	    if (sheet === 51 && st.wall[i] === 62) this.roll(4);
224	    const n = killDustAmount(sheet);
225	    const amt = n === -1 ? (st.frameX[i] / 22 >= 5 ? 5 : 10) : n;
226	    const per = killDustRollsPer(sheet, st.frameX[i]);
227	    for (let k = 0; k < amt; k++) for (let r = 0; r < per; r++) this.roll(6);
228	    // cs:63941：地狱石(58) 击杀于 UnderworldLayer(=h-200) 之下 → 灌岩浆 128
229	    if (sheet === 58 && y > st.h - 200) { st.liquid[i] = 128; st.liquidType[i] = 2; }
230	    st.setTileSilent(x, y, 0);
231	  }

234	   *  （钩子缺位）走 killTileGen——原版 WaterCheck(:81172-81187 死亡表击杀)/
235	   *  LiquidCheck(:1288-1295 非水本格+下方裁切植物)/CreateLiquidMergeTile(:1370)
236	   *  三条触发链在沉降期同样生效（#97 vanilla 实测 KillTile 844 格） */
237	  private killTileAt(x: number, y: number): void {
238	    if (this.killTile) { this.killTile(x, y); return; }
239	    if (this.isGeneratingOrLoadingWorld) this.killTileGen(x, y);
240	  }

260	   *  QuickWater 全程全局置非实心（原版直接改写 Main.tileSolid——SettleWaterAt 通行
261	   *  门与 LiquidCheck 的 WorldGen.SolidTile 等一切读者同步生效）。484 活性格在
262	   *  地下沙漠大量存在：缺此翻转=沙漠水池沉降路径整体错位（#28 复验实测 430 格）。 */

268	  constructor(world: World) {
269	    this.world = world;
270	    const st = world.store;
271	    this.checking = new Uint8Array(st.w * st.h);
272	    this.skip = new Uint8Array(st.w * st.h);
273	    // sheet → 内部 id 反查（死亡表/烧除表用）
274	    const bySheet = (sheets: Set<number>): Set<number> => new Set(
275	      TILE_DEFS.reduce<number[]>((acc, d, id) => { if (d.vanilla && sheets.has(d.vanilla.sheet)) acc.push(id); return acc; }, []),
276	    );
277	    this.waterDeathIds = bySheet(WATER_DEATH_SHEETS);
278	    this.lavaDeathIds = bySheet(LAVA_DEATH_SHEETS);
279	    this.lavaBurnAirIds = bySheet(LAVA_BURN_TO_AIR);
280	    this.lavaBurnDirtIds = bySheet(LAVA_BURN_TO_DIRT);
281	    this.mudId = TILE_BY_KEY['mud'];
282	    // tileObsidianKill = lavaDeath ∪ 附加 − {88}（Main.cs:8214-8220，88=梳妆台显式豁免）
283	    const okKill = bySheet(OBSIDIAN_KILL_EXTRA_SHEETS);
284	    for (const id of this.lavaDeathIds) okKill.add(id);
285	    for (const id of bySheet(new Set([88]))) okKill.delete(id);
286	    this.obsidianKillIds = okKill;
287	    this.cutIds = bySheet(CUT_SHEETS);
288	    this.containerIds = bySheet(CONTAINER_SHEETS);
289	    this.alchIds = bySheet(ALCH_SHEETS);
290	    this.alchSoilIds = ALCH_SOIL_SHEETS.map((s) => bySheet(s));
291	    this.herbSproutId = bySheet(new Set([82])).values().next().value ?? 0;
292	    this.herbMatureId = bySheet(new Set([83])).values().next().value ?? 0;
293	    this.herbBloomId = bySheet(new Set([84])).values().next().value ?? 0;
294	    this.lilyPadId = bySheet(new Set([518])).values().next().value ?? 0;
295	    this.boulderFamilyIds = bySheet(new Set([138, 484, 664, 711, 712, 713, 714, 715, 716]));
296	    this.id546 = bySheet(new Set([546])).values().next().value ?? -1;
297	    this.id379 = bySheet(new Set([379])).values().next().value ?? -1;
298	    // genRand 初态：world.seed 派生（避免与生成管线的 genRand 状态纠缠，仅求双路径一致）
299	    this.genState = (world.seed ^ 0x9e3779b9) | 0;
300	    // 挖掘/放置唤醒：原版 SquareTileFrame 会对 3×3 内每格 TileFrame→AddWater（WorldGen.cs:49664）
301	    st.onTileChanged((x, y) => {
302	      if (this.disposed) return;
303	      for (let dy = -1; dy <= 1; dy++)
304	        for (let dx = -1; dx <= 1; dx++) this.addWater(x + dx, y + dy);
305	    });
306	    // 液体直接写入（水桶等）：唤醒目标及四邻
307	    st.onLiquidChanged((x, y) => {
308	      if (this.disposed) return;
309	      this.addWater(x, y);
310	      this.addWater(x, y - 1); this.addWater(x, y + 1);
311	      this.addWater(x - 1, y); this.addWater(x + 1, y);
312	    });
313	    // 实心 LUT(零风险:TILE_DEFS 构造后不变;逐 id 用原判定式预计算)。
314	    // solidFull 不可整体预计算——half/slope 是格级属性,仅把 TILE_DEFS 链换成 LUT。
315	    const NT = TILE_DEFS.length;
316	    this.solidNP = new Uint8Array(NT);
317	    for (let id = 0; id < NT; id++) {
318	      const d = TILE_DEFS[id];
319	      if (d && d.solid && !d.platform) this.solidNP[id] = 1;
320	    }
321	  }

323	  /** 溢出缓冲长度（Game 的生成期轮上限计算用，原版 LiquidBuffer.numLiquidBuffer） */
324	  get bufferLen(): number { return this.bufTail - this.bufHead; }
325	
326	  /** 丢弃模拟器：预沉降临时实例调用，停止响应唤醒 */
327	  dispose() {
328	    this.disposed = true;
329	    this.liquids.length = 0;
330	    this.numLiquid = 0;
331	  }

333	  private idx(x: number, y: number): number { return y * this.world.store.w + x; }
334	
335	  /** 格子是否阻挡液体（原版 nactive() && tileSolid && !tileSolidTop）。
336	   *  nactive() 要求 active 位——生成期 TileRunner 会在空气格写幽灵 type（flags=0），
337	   *  无 active 的一律视为空气（否则微光池会被 waterCheck 当实心格清零泄流） */
338	  private blocksLiquid(x: number, y: number): boolean {
339	    const st = this.world.store;
340	    if (x < 0 || y < 0 || x >= st.w || y >= st.h) return true;
341	    const i = this.idx(x, y);
342	    if (!st.flags[i]) return false;
343	    return this.solidNP[st.type[i]] === 1;
344	  }
345	
346	  /** WorldGen.SolidTile 语义（WorldGen.cs:42370）：实心 && !平台 && !半砖 && !坡面。
347	   *  仅 LavaCheck/HoneyCheck/ShimmerCheck 入口使用——半砖格允许发生交互（Liquid.cs:898/1020） */
348	  private solidTileFull(x: number, y: number): boolean {
349	    const st = this.world.store;
350	    if (x < 0 || y < 0 || x >= st.w || y >= st.h) return true;
351	    const i = this.idx(x, y);
352	    if (!st.flags[i]) return false;
353	    return this.solidNP[st.type[i]] === 1 && !st.half[i] && st.slope[i] === 0;
354	  }

356	  // ================= AddWater（Liquid.cs:835-872） =================
357	
358	  addWater(x: number, y: number) {
359	    const st = this.world.store;
360	    if (x >= st.w - 5 || y >= st.h - 5 || x < 5 || y < 5) return;
361	    const i = this.idx(x, y);
362	    if (this.checking[i] || st.liquid[i] === 0) return;
363	    const t = st.type[i];
364	    if (t !== 0 && st.flags[i]) {
365	      if (this.solidNP[t] === 1) return;
366	    }
367	    if (this.numLiquid >= this.curMaxLiquid - 1) {
368	      // 原版走 LiquidBuffer 缓冲、清扫轮回灌（Liquid.cs:840-843），超缓冲上限才丢
369	      if (this.bufTail - this.bufHead < LiquidSim.BUFFER_CAP) {
370	        if (this.bufTail === LiquidSim.BUFFER_CAP) {
371	          // ★到顶且 head>0:前移压缩(原版 Array.shift 后 push 可重新装满;曾漏此步
372	          // → 越界写静默丢条目,与原版容量语义不等价,A/B 哈希报警)
373	          this.bufX.copyWithin(0, this.bufHead, this.bufTail);
374	          this.bufY.copyWithin(0, this.bufHead, this.bufTail);
375	          this.bufTail -= this.bufHead;
376	          this.bufHead = 0;
377	        }
378	        this.bufX[this.bufTail] = x;
379	        this.bufY[this.bufTail] = y;
380	        this.bufTail++;
381	        // LiquidBuffer.AddBuffer :115:入队即置 checkingLiquid——缺此则同 tick 同格
382	        // 二次 AddWater 会重复入队(原版经 :13 checkingLiquid 门拒绝;清扫 :380
383	        // 先清后 addWater 语义不变)
384	        this.checking[i] = 1;
385	      }
386	      return;
387	    }
388	    this.checking[i] = 1;
389	    this.skip[i] = 0;
390	    this.liquids[this.numLiquid] = { x, y, kill: 0, delay: 0 };
391	    this.numLiquid++;
392	    // 1456 AddWater 尾部（L1196-1211）：岩浆/水冲毁可死亡方块（火把/植物等 KillTile）。
393	    //  与 blocksLiquid 同理走 nactive（幽灵 type 不算实心）。★isGeneratingOrLoading
394	    //  World 门槛（L1199 `!tile.active() || isGeneratingOrLoadingWorld → return`）：
395	    //  生成/读档沉降期此链不发击杀（击杀走 WaterCheck/LiquidCheck 两链）
396	    if (!this.isGeneratingOrLoadingWorld && t !== 0 && st.flags[i]) {
397	      const isLava = st.liquidType[i] === 2;
398	      const dies = isLava ? this.lavaDeathIds.has(t) : this.waterDeathIds.has(t);
399	      if (dies) this.killTileAt(x, y);
400	    }
401	  }
402	
403	  // ================= UpdateLiquid 调度（Liquid.cs:691-833） =================
404	
405	  /** 每 2 个逻辑 tick 调一次（原版 WorldGen.UpdateWorld 内 skipCount 节流） */
406	  step() { this.updateLiquid(); }
407	
408	  updateLiquid() {
409	    const st = this.world.store;
410	    const killThreshold = 8; // 单机 num（1456 Liquid.cs:995）
411	    // panic 模式（1456 Liquid.cs:1019-1070）：缓冲 ≥45000 持续 3600 次未解 →
412	    // 自底向上逐行 QuickWater 强制沉降，每次调用处理 5 行，到顶后 WaterCheck 退出
413	    if (!this.quickSettle) {
414	      if (!this.panicMode) {
415	        if (this.bufTail - this.bufHead >= 45000) {
416	          this.panicCounter++;
417	          if (this.panicCounter > 3600) {
418	            this.panicMode = true;
419	            this.panicCounter = 0;
420	            this.panicY = st.h - 3;
421	            this.liquids.length = 0;
422	            this.numLiquid = 0;
423	            this.bufHead = 0; this.bufTail = 0;
424	          }
425	        } else {
426	          this.panicCounter = 0;
427	        }
428	      }
429	      if (this.panicMode) {
430	        let n = 0;
431	        while (this.panicY >= 3 && n < 5) {
432	          n++;
433	          this.quickWater(this.panicY, this.panicY);
434	          this.panicY--;
435	        }
436	        if (this.panicY < 3) {
437	          this.panicMode = false;
438	          this.panicCounter = 0;
439	          this.waterCheck();
440	        }
441	        return;
442	      }
443	    }
444	    const quickSettle = this.quickSettle;
445	    // quickFall 跟随 quickSettle（Liquid.cs:752-755，未受 gen 门限）；但 cycles=1 的
446	    // Main.cs:12251 分支被 !WorldGen.gen 限定——读档沉降期 gen=true 不生效，保持分片
447	    this.quickFall = quickSettle;
448	    const cycles = this.cycles;
449	    this.wetCounter++;
450	    const slice = Math.floor(this.curMaxLiquid / cycles);
451	    const start = slice * (this.wetCounter - 1);
452	    let end = slice * this.wetCounter;
453	    if (this.wetCounter === cycles) end = this.numLiquid;
454	    if (end > this.numLiquid) { end = this.numLiquid; this.wetCounter = cycles; }
455	    if (this.quickFall) {
456	      for (let l = start; l < end; l++) {
457	        const e = this.liquids[l];
458	        e.delay = 10;
459	        this.update(e);
460	        this.skip[this.idx(e.x, e.y)] = 0;
461	      }
462	    } else {
463	      for (let l = start; l < end; l++) {
464	        const e = this.liquids[l];
465	        const i = this.idx(e.x, e.y);
466	        if (!this.skip[i]) this.update(e);
467	        else this.skip[i] = 0;
468	      }
469	    }
470	    if (this.wetCounter >= cycles) {
471	      this.wetCounter = 0;
472	      // 清扫：kill 累积达标 → 254 补满 255 后出列（Liquid.cs:790-798）
473	      for (let l = this.numLiquid - 1; l >= 0; l--) {
474	        const e = this.liquids[l];
475	        if (e.kill >= killThreshold) {
476	          const i = this.idx(e.x, e.y);
477	          if (st.liquid[i] === 254) st.liquid[i] = 255;
478	          this.delWater(l);
479	        }
480	      }
481	      // LiquidBuffer 回灌：按剩余空位逐个重新入列（Liquid.cs:799-807）
482	      if (this.bufTail > this.bufHead) {
483	        const free = Math.min(this.curMaxLiquid - this.numLiquid, this.bufTail - this.bufHead);
484	        for (let n = 0; n < free; n++) {
485	          const bx = this.bufX[this.bufHead];
486	          const by = this.bufY[this.bufHead];
487	          this.bufHead++;
488	          this.checking[this.idx(bx, by)] = 0;
489	          this.addWater(bx, by);
490	        }
491	      }
492	      // 卡死检测：活动量长期不变 → 清空列表靠唤醒自愈（Liquid.cs:808-824）
493	      if (this.numLiquid > 0 && this.numLiquid > this.stuckAmount - 50 && this.numLiquid < this.stuckAmount + 50) {
494	        this.stuckCount++;
495	        if (this.stuckCount >= 10000) {
496	          this.stuck = true;
497	          for (let l = this.numLiquid - 1; l >= 0; l--) this.delWater(l);
498	          this.stuck = false;
499	          this.stuckCount = 0;
500	        }
501	      } else {
502	        this.stuckCount = 0;
503	        this.stuckAmount = this.numLiquid;
504	      }
505	    }
506	  }
507	
508	  // ================= 单格流程 Update（Liquid.cs:298-674） =================
509	
510	  private update(e: LiquidEntry) {
511	    const st = this.world.store;
512	    const w = st.w, h = st.h;

536	        const ny = y + (t === 2 ? -1 : t === 3 ? 1 : 0);
537	        if (nx < 0 || ny < 0 || nx >= w || ny >= h) continue;

609	  /** 侧向均流：参与格全体写平均值（Liquid.cs:398-651，逐分支照抄） */
610	  private sideFlow(x: number, y: number, i5: number) {
611	    const st = this.world.store;
612	    const myType = st.liquidType[i5];
613	    const il = i5 - 1, ir = i5 + 1, iu = i5 - st.w, im2 = i5 - 2, ip2 = i5 + 2, im3 = i5 - 3, ip3 = i5 + 3;
614	    const lq = st.liquid[il], rq = st.liquid[ir];
615	    // flag1 左可流 / flag2 右可流 / flag3 左 2 格延伸 / flag4 右 2 格延伸

617	    if (this.blocksLiquid(x - 1, y)) f1 = false;
618	    else if (lq > 0 && st.liquidType[il] !== myType) f1 = false;
619	    else if (this.blocksLiquid(x - 2, y)) f3 = false;
620	    else if (st.liquid[im2] === 0) f3 = false;
621	    else if (st.liquidType[im2] !== myType) f3 = false;
622	    if (this.blocksLiquid(x + 1, y)) f2 = false;
623	    else if (rq > 0 && st.liquidType[ir] !== myType) f2 = false;
624	    else if (this.blocksLiquid(x + 2, y)) f4 = false;
625	    else if (st.liquid[ip2] === 0) f4 = false;
626	    else if (st.liquidType[ip2] !== myType) f4 = false;
627	    let num1 = 0;
628	    if (st.liquid[i5] < 3) num1 = -1;         // 薄层蒸发偏置（Liquid.cs:424-426）
629	    if (st.liquid[i5] > 250) { f3 = false; f4 = false; }
630	    if (f1 && f2) {

633	        let f5 = true, f6 = true;

635	        else if (st.liquid[im3] === 0) f5 = false;
636	        else if (st.liquidType[im3] !== myType) f5 = false;
637	        if (this.blocksLiquid(x + 3, y)) f6 = false;
638	        else if (st.liquid[ip3] === 0) f6 = false;
639	        else if (st.liquidType[ip3] !== myType) f6 = false;
640	        if (f5 && f6) {

642	          const m = csRound((lq + rq + st.liquid[im2] + st.liquid[ip2] + st.liquid[im3] + st.liquid[ip3] + st.liquid[i5] + num1) / 7); // 1456 Math.Round=取偶
643	          let same = 0;
644	          if (lq !== m) { st.liquidType[il] = myType; st.liquid[il] = m; this.addWater(x - 1, y); } else { st.liquidType[il] = myType; same++; }
645	          if (rq !== m) { st.liquidType[ir] = myType; st.liquid[ir] = m; this.addWater(x + 1, y); } else { st.liquidType[ir] = myType; same++; }
646	          if (st.liquid[im2] !== m) { st.liquidType[im2] = myType; st.liquid[im2] = m; this.addWater(x - 2, y); } else { st.liquidType[im2] = myType; same++; }
647	          if (st.liquid[ip2] !== m) { st.liquidType[ip2] = myType; st.liquid[ip2] = m; this.addWater(x + 2, y); } else { st.liquidType[ip2] = myType; same++; }
648	          if (st.liquid[im3] !== m) { st.liquidType[im3] = myType; st.liquid[im3] = m; this.addWater(x - 3, y); } else { st.liquidType[im3] = myType; same++; }
649	          if (st.liquid[ip3] !== m) { st.liquidType[ip3] = myType; st.liquid[ip3] = m; this.addWater(x + 3, y); } else { st.liquidType[ip3] = myType; same++; }
650	          // 补偿唤醒：中心可能保持原值，邻居需按"邻居≠均值或中心≠均值"重唤醒（Liquid.cs:502-513）

652	          if (st.liquid[ir] !== m || st.liquid[i5] !== m) this.addWater(x + 1, y);
653	          if (st.liquid[im2] !== m || st.liquid[i5] !== m) this.addWater(x - 2, y);
654	          if (st.liquid[ip2] !== m || st.liquid[i5] !== m) this.addWater(x + 2, y);
655	          if (st.liquid[im3] !== m || st.liquid[i5] !== m) this.addWater(x - 3, y);
656	          if (st.liquid[ip3] !== m || st.liquid[i5] !== m) this.addWater(x + 3, y);

663	          if (lq !== m) { st.liquidType[il] = myType; st.liquid[il] = m; this.addWater(x - 1, y); } else { st.liquidType[il] = myType; same++; }
664	          if (rq !== m) { st.liquidType[ir] = myType; st.liquid[ir] = m; this.addWater(x + 1, y); } else { st.liquidType[ir] = myType; same++; }
665	          if (st.liquid[im2] !== m) { st.liquidType[im2] = myType; st.liquid[im2] = m; this.addWater(x - 2, y); } else { st.liquidType[im2] = myType; same++; }
666	          if (st.liquid[ip2] !== m) { st.liquidType[ip2] = myType; st.liquid[ip2] = m; this.addWater(x + 2, y); } else { st.liquidType[ip2] = myType; same++; }
667	          // 补偿唤醒（Liquid.cs:553-560）
668	          if (st.liquid[il] !== m || st.liquid[i5] !== m) this.addWater(x - 1, y);
669	          if (st.liquid[ir] !== m || st.liquid[i5] !== m) this.addWater(x + 1, y);
670	          if (st.liquid[im2] !== m || st.liquid[i5] !== m) this.addWater(x - 2, y);
671	          if (st.liquid[ip2] !== m || st.liquid[i5] !== m) this.addWater(x + 2, y);
672	          if (same !== 4 || st.liquid[iu] <= 0) st.liquid[i5] = m;
673	        }
674	      } else if (f3) {
675	        // 4 格：左延伸（Liquid.cs:567-587）。类型写在条件判断之前（原版 L568 无条件写）
676	        const m = csRound((lq + rq + st.liquid[im2] + st.liquid[i5] + num1) / 4); // 1456 Math.Round=取偶
677	        st.liquidType[il] = myType;
678	        if (lq !== m || st.liquid[i5] !== m) { st.liquid[il] = m; this.addWater(x - 1, y); }
679	        st.liquidType[ir] = myType;
680	        if (rq !== m || st.liquid[i5] !== m) { st.liquid[ir] = m; this.addWater(x + 1, y); }
681	        st.liquidType[im2] = myType;
682	        if (st.liquid[im2] !== m || st.liquid[i5] !== m) { st.liquid[im2] = m; this.addWater(x - 2, y); }
683	        st.liquid[i5] = m;
684	      } else if (f4) {
685	        // 4 格：右延伸（Liquid.cs:590-609）。类型写在条件判断之前（原版 L591 无条件写）
686	        const m = csRound((lq + rq + st.liquid[ip2] + st.liquid[i5] + num1) / 4); // 1456 Math.Round=取偶
687	        st.liquidType[il] = myType;
688	        if (lq !== m || st.liquid[i5] !== m) { st.liquid[il] = m; this.addWater(x - 1, y); }
689	        st.liquidType[ir] = myType;
690	        if (rq !== m || st.liquid[i5] !== m) { st.liquid[ir] = m; this.addWater(x + 1, y); }
691	        st.liquidType[ip2] = myType;
692	        if (st.liquid[ip2] !== m || st.liquid[i5] !== m) { st.liquid[ip2] = m; this.addWater(x + 2, y); }

694	      } else {
695	        // 3 格均分（Liquid.cs:613-628）：随机 254→255 补满
696	        let m = csRound((lq + rq + st.liquid[i5] + num1) / 3); // 1456 Math.Round=取偶
697	        if (m === 254 && this.roll(30) === 0) m = 255; // 原版 WorldGen.genRand.Next(30)==0（gen 期走 pass 链流）
698	        if (lq !== m) { st.liquidType[il] = myType; st.liquid[il] = m; this.addWater(x - 1, y); } else st.liquidType[il] = myType;
699	        if (rq !== m) { st.liquidType[ir] = myType; st.liquid[ir] = m; this.addWater(x + 1, y); } else st.liquidType[ir] = myType;

719	  // ================= 液体交互（Liquid.cs:888-1115 + GetLiquidMergeTypes 1385-1453） =================
720	  // 合并产物优先级（GetLiquidMergeTypes 逐段覆盖，后写胜出）：
721	  //   水 > 岩浆 > 蜂蜜 > 微光——任一方是微光 → Aetherium 块 659；
722	  //   否则 蜂蜜在场 → 229/230，只剩水岩组合 → 黑曜石 56
723	
724	  /** CreateLiquidMergeTile（Liquid.cs:1355-1384）：
725	   *  生成/读档期 → LiquidOverwriteStrip（整行液体类型统一，不落块）；
726	   *  运行期 → PlayLiquidChangeSound + ReplaceTile/KillTile+PlaceTile（掉落走 killTile 钩子） */
727	  private createMergeTile(x: number, y: number, tileType: number, thisType: number, mergeType: number) {
728	    const st = this.world.store;
729	    if (this.isGeneratingOrLoadingWorld && !this.createMergeTilesDuringGen) {
730	      // Liquid.cs:1360-1377：产物 → 源类型（229→水 230/56→岩浆 659→微光），
731	      // 地狱层强制岩浆；两处调用点目标格已预先清零 → strip 实为空操作，仅保留原版结构
732	      let stripType = -1;
733	      if (tileType === HONEY_BLOCK) stripType = 1;
734	      else if (tileType === CRISPY_HONEY || tileType === OBSIDIAN) stripType = 2;
735	      else if (tileType === AETHERIUM) stripType = 4;
736	      if (y >= st.h - 200) stripType = 2; // y >= UnderworldLayer
737	      if (stripType >= 0) this.liquidOverwriteStrip(x, y, stripType);
738	      return;
739	    }
740	    this.liquidChangeSound?.(x, y, thisType, mergeType); // WorldGen.PlayLiquidChangeSound
741	    const i = this.idx(x, y);
742	    if (st.flags[i]) this.killTileAt(x, y); // ReplaceTile：KillTile_DropItems（火把/植物掉落）；生成收尾=尘掷
743	    st.setTile(x, y, tileType);
744	  }

746	  /** LiquidOverwriteStrip（Liquid.cs:1338-1352）：从 (x,y) 起向两侧延伸，
747	   *  把同行连续液体段的类型统一为 stripType */
748	  private liquidOverwriteStrip(x: number, y: number, stripType: number) {
749	    const st = this.world.store;
750	    for (let nx = x; nx >= 0 && st.liquid[this.idx(nx, y)] > 0; nx--) st.liquidType[this.idx(nx, y)] = stripType;
751	    for (let nx = x; nx < st.w && st.liquid[this.idx(nx, y)] > 0; nx++) st.liquidType[this.idx(nx, y)] = stripType;
752	  }

754	  /** 生成收尾全图 LiquidCheck(createMergeTilesDuringGen:true)（WorldGen.cs:22639-22650）：
755	   *  常规生成期交互不落块（strip 分支），唯独收尾这一次允许把残余接触转成块 */
756	  finalGenMergeCheck() {
757	    const st = this.world.store;
758	    this.createMergeTilesDuringGen = true;
759	    try {
760	      for (let y = 1; y < st.h - 1; y++) {
761	        const row = y * st.w;
762	        for (let x = 1; x < st.w - 1; x++) {
763	          const i = row + x;
764	          if (st.liquid[i] === 0) continue;
765	          const t = st.liquidType[i];
766	          if (t === 2) this.lavaCheck(x, y);
767	          else if (t === 3) this.honeyCheck(x, y);
768	          else if (t === 4) this.shimmerCheck(x, y);
769	        }
770	      }
771	    } finally {
772	      this.createMergeTilesDuringGen = false;
773	    }
774	  }

776	  /** UndergroundDesertCheck（Liquid.cs:1217-1231）：(x,y) 周围 7×7 有地下沙漠墙
777	   *  （187 沙岩墙 / 216 硬化沙墙）即真。dump027 实证本时点沙漠墙 18.5 万格。 */
778	  private undergroundDesertCheck(x: number, y: number): boolean {
779	    const st = this.world.store;
780	    for (let j = y - 3; j <= y + 3; j++) {
781	      for (let i = x - 3; i <= x + 3; i++) {
782	        if (i < 0 || j < 0 || i >= st.w || j >= st.h) continue; // InWorld(fluff=0)
783	        const wv = st.wall[this.idx(i, j)];
784	        if (wv === 187 || wv === 216) return true;
785	      }
786	    }
787	    return false;
788	  }

790	  /** 岩浆格与水/蜂蜜/微光接触 → 黑曜石 56 / 脆蜂蜜块 230 / Aetherium 659（阈值 24） */
791	  private lavaCheck(x: number, y: number) {
792	    const st = this.world.store;
793	    // LavaCheck 头部沙漠分支（Liquid.cs:1457-1465）：生成期 + 7×7 含地下沙漠墙 →
794	    // 整块 7×7 液体**类型**转岩浆（lava(true) 不动量）——地下沙漠底岩浆池来源，且使
795	    // 沙漠内水岩接触不互湮（转同型后 LiquidCheck 无异种邻）。remixWorldGen/
796	    // dualDungeonsSeed 为特殊种子旗标，本工程不启用。须在 SolidTile 门之前（原版序）。
797	    if (this.generatingWorld && this.undergroundDesertCheck(x, y)) {
798	      for (let j = y - 3; j <= y + 3; j++) {
799	        for (let i = x - 3; i <= x + 3; i++) {
800	          if (i < 0 || j < 0 || i >= st.w || j >= st.h) continue;
801	          st.liquidType[this.idx(i, j)] = 2;
802	        }
803	      }
804	    }
805	    if (this.solidTileFull(x, y)) return; // WorldGen.SolidTile：半砖/坡面放行（Liquid.cs:898）
806	    const i5 = this.idx(x, y);
807	    const il = i5 - 1, ir = i5 + 1, iu = i5 - st.w, id = i5 + st.w;
808	    const lq = st.liquid[il], rq = st.liquid[ir], uq = st.liquid[iu], dq = st.liquid[id];
809	    const lt = st.liquidType[il], rt = st.liquidType[ir], ut = st.liquidType[iu], dt = st.liquidType[id];
810	    if ((lq > 0 && lt !== 2) || (rq > 0 && rt !== 2) || (uq > 0 && ut !== 2)) {
811	      // 情形 A：左右/上方有非岩浆液体 → 生成在岩浆格（Liquid.cs:905-959）
812	      let sum = 0;
813	      let type = OBSIDIAN;
814	      let mergeType = 1;
815	      if (lt !== 2) { sum += lq; st.liquid[il] = 0; }
816	      if (rt !== 2) { sum += rq; st.liquid[ir] = 0; }
817	      if (ut !== 2) { sum += uq; st.liquid[iu] = 0; }
818	      if (lt === 3 || rt === 3 || ut === 3) { type = CRISPY_HONEY; mergeType = 3; }
819	      if (lt === 4 || rt === 4 || ut === 4) { type = AETHERIUM; mergeType = 4; } // 微光优先级最高（L1443-1451）
820	      if (sum < 24) return;

879	      const containerOk = selfAct && this.containerIds.has(selfT) && !(belowAct && this.containerIds.has(belowT));
880	      // 非水本格 + 下方裁切植物 → 先 KillTile 掉落（Liquid.cs:1289-1295）

882	      if (st.flags[id] !== 0 && !this.obsidianKillIds.has(st.type[id]) && !containerOk) return;
883	      if (st.liquid[i5] < 24) { st.liquid[i5] = 0; st.liquidType[i5] = 0; return; } // 1456 统一 24

932	  // ================= DelWater（Liquid.cs:1117-1213） =================

934	  private delWater(l: number) {
935	    const st = this.world.store;
936	    const e = this.liquids[l];
937	    const x = e.x, y = e.y;
938	    const i5 = this.idx(x, y);
939	    const il = i5 - 1, ir = i5 + 1, id = i5 + st.w;
940	    const amt = st.liquid[i5];
941	    if (amt < 2) {
942	      // 残量清零 + 邻居唤醒（Liquid.cs:1125-1137）
943	      st.liquid[i5] = 0;
944	      if (st.liquid[il] < 2) st.liquid[il] = 0; else this.addWater(x - 1, y);
945	      if (st.liquid[ir] < 2) st.liquid[ir] = 0; else this.addWater(x + 1, y);
946	    } else if (amt < 20) {
947	      // 水膜抹除：邻格更低或下方不满（Liquid.cs:1138-1142）
948	      const lq = st.liquid[il], rq = st.liquid[ir], dq = st.liquid[id];
949	      if ((lq < amt && !this.blocksLiquid(x - 1, y)) ||
950	          (rq < amt && !this.blocksLiquid(x + 1, y)) ||
951	          (dq < 255 && !this.blocksLiquid(x, y + 1))) {
952	        st.liquid[i5] = 0;
953	      }
954	    } else if (st.liquid[id] < 255 && !this.blocksLiquid(x, y + 1) && !this.stuck && !this.blocksLiquid(x, y)) {
955	      e.kill = 0; // 下方未满：留在列表继续流（Liquid.cs:1143-1147）
956	      return;
957	    }
958	    if (st.liquid[i5] < 250 && st.liquid[i5 - st.w] > 0) this.addWater(x, y - 1);
959	    if (st.liquid[i5] === 0) {
960	      st.liquidType[i5] = 0;
961	    } else {
962	      const rq = st.liquid[ir], lq = st.liquid[il];
963	      if (rq > 0 && rq < 250 && !this.blocksLiquid(x + 1, y) && st.liquid[i5] !== rq) this.addWater(x + 1, y);
964	      if (lq > 0 && lq < 250 && !this.blocksLiquid(x - 1, y) && st.liquid[i5] !== lq) this.addWater(x - 1, y);
965	      if (st.liquidType[i5] === 2) {
966	        this.lavaCheck(x, y);
967	        // 岩浆 3×3 烧除（1456 DelWater L1557-1587）：草族(2/23/109/199/477/492)→空气；
968	        // 蘑菇草族(60/70/661/662)→泥土 59——经 sheet 反查内部 id 精确映射
969	        for (let dy = -1; dy <= 1; dy++) {
970	          for (let dx = -1; dx <= 1; dx++) {
971	            const nx = x + dx, ny = y + dy;
972	            if (nx < 1 || ny < 1 || nx >= st.w - 1 || ny >= st.h - 1) continue;
973	            const ni = this.idx(nx, ny);
974	            const t = st.type[ni];
975	            if (t === 0) continue;
976	            if (this.lavaBurnAirIds.has(t)) st.setTile(nx, ny, 0);
977	            else if (this.lavaBurnDirtIds.has(t)) st.setTile(nx, ny, this.mudId); // cs:1562 type=59（泥，非泥土0——曾误写 dirt）
978	          }
979	        }
980	      } else if (st.liquidType[i5] === 3) {
981	        this.honeyCheck(x, y);
982	      } else if (st.liquidType[i5] === 4) {
983	        this.shimmerCheck(x, y); // Liquid.cs:1576-1579 tile4.shimmer() → ShimmerCheck
984	      }
985	    }
986	    // swap-remove（Liquid.cs:1193-1197）：只搬 x/y/kill，delay 保留本槽旧值（原版语义）
987	    this.numLiquid--;
988	    this.checking[i5] = 0;
989	    const tail = this.liquids[this.numLiquid];
990	    e.x = tail.x; e.y = tail.y; e.kill = tail.kill;
991	    this.liquids.length = this.numLiquid;
992	    // DelWater 尾部（Liquid.cs:1607-1624）：出列格是草药 → CheckAlch 依附复查；
993	    // 是睡莲(518) → 快沉降/静水时 CheckLilyPad，否则仅 SquareTileFrame（本仓库帧为
994	    // 渲染期派生，该分支无操作）
995	    if (st.flags[i5]) {
996	      if (this.alchIds.has(st.type[i5])) this.checkAlch(x, y);
997	      else if (st.type[i5] === this.lilyPadId) {
998	        const iu = i5 - st.w;
999	        if (this.quickFall) this.checkLilyPad(x, y);
1000	        else if (st.liquid[id] < 255 || st.liquid[iu] > 0) { /* SquareTileFrame：帧由渲染派生 */ }
1001	        else this.checkLilyPad(x, y);
1002	      }
1003	    }
1004	  }

1006	  /** WorldGen.CheckAlch（WorldGen.cs:45981-46109）：液体退去后复查草药依附。
1007	   *  frameX/18 = 生长阶段 0-6，各阶段允许的下方泥土不同；frameY 强制归 0；
1008	   *  阶段 5 附带岩浆 bloom 切换（液体>16 → 83 成熟→84 绽放，反之退回） */
1009	  private checkAlch(x: number, y: number) {
1010	    const st = this.world.store;
1011	    const i5 = this.idx(x, y);
1012	    const id = this.idx(x, y + 1);
1013	    let bad = false;
1014	    if (!st.flags[id]) bad = true;      // 下方无 active tile
1015	    if (st.half[id]) bad = true;        // halfBrick 不算依附面
1016	    const stage = (st.frameX[i5] / 18) | 0;
1017	    st.frameY[i5] = 0;
1018	    if (!bad && stage >= 0 && stage < this.alchSoilIds.length) {
1019	      if (!this.alchSoilIds[stage].has(st.type[id])) bad = true;
1020	      if (st.liquid[i5] > 0 && st.liquidType[i5] === 2) bad = true; // 草药泡岩浆必枯
1021	    }
1022	    if (bad) { this.killTileAt(x, y); return; }
1023	    // 阶段 5 bloom 切换（45981+ case 5 尾段）：Daybloom(82) 豁免，仅岩浆格生效
1024	    if (stage !== 5) return;
1025	    const t = st.type[i5];
1026	    if (t === this.herbSproutId || st.liquidType[i5] !== 2) return;
1027	    if (st.liquid[i5] > 16) {
1028	      if (t === this.herbMatureId) st.setTile(x, y, this.herbBloomId, st.frameX[i5], st.frameY[i5]);
1029	    } else if (t === this.herbBloomId) {
1030	      st.setTile(x, y, this.herbMatureId, st.frameX[i5], st.frameY[i5]);
1031	    }
1032	  }

1034	  /** WorldGen.CheckLilyPad（WorldGen.cs:59227-59324）：睡莲只能浮在水面——
1035	   *  非水即 KillTile；frameY 按水底泥土族选行（0/18/36）；水位涨落整体上下移一格 */
1036	  private checkLilyPad(x: number, y: number) {
1037	    const st = this.world.store;
1038	    const i5 = this.idx(x, y);
1039	    if (st.liquidType[i5] !== 1) { this.killTileAt(x, y); return; } // 非水 → 掉落清除
1040	    // 向下找第一个实心格（原版 tileSolid && !tileSolidTop；tileSolidTop 的家具族

1042	    let fy = y;
1043	    for (;;) {
1044	      const fi = this.idx(x, fy);
1045	      const d = TILE_DEFS[st.type[fi]];
1046	      if (st.flags[fi] && d?.solid && !d.platform) break;
1047	      if (fy >= st.h - 50) { this.killTileAt(x, y); return; } // 落不到底 → 清除

1060	      st.setTile(x, y - 1, this.lilyPadId, st.frameX[i5], st.frameY[i5]);
1061	      st.setTile(x, y, 0);
1062	    } else {
1063	      if (st.liquid[i5] !== 0) return; // 本格仍有液体 → 保持
1064	      const belowDef = TILE_DEFS[st.type[ib]];
1065	      if (!st.flags[ib]) {
1066	        // 下方退水成空 → 下移一格（59289-59304）
1067	        st.setTile(x, y + 1, this.lilyPadId, st.frameX[i5], st.frameY[i5]);
1068	        st.setTile(x, y, 0);
1069	      } else if (!belowDef?.platform && (!belowDef?.solid)) {
1070	        // 下方被非平台实心家具占据 → 掉落清除（59305-59312）
1071	        this.killTileAt(x, y);
1072	      }
1073	    }
1074	  }

    world.genWaterLine = gs.waterLine;
    if (gs.dungeonSide === 0) {

    } else {

  flipGenSolid([484], false);

  HOME=/tmp/sw-num4/home SW_NUM4_TRAJ=/tmp/sw-num4/traj_$seed.csv \

    -port 7779 -noupnp -difficulty 0 </dev/null > /tmp/sw-num4/gen_$seed.log 2>&1 &
  p=$!

    if [ "$n" -ge 4200 ]; then sleep 5; ok=1; break; fi
  done
  pkill -f TerrariaServer.bin.osx 2>/dev/null
  kill $p 2>/dev/null
  echo "seed=$seed rows=$(wc -l < /tmp/sw-num4/traj_$seed.csv 2>/dev/null || echo 0) ok=$ok"
done
pkill -f TerrariaServer.bin.osx 2>/dev/null
echo "BATCH-DONE"

class UR {
  constructor(seed){ this.sa=new Int32Array(56); this.inext=0; this.setSeed(seed); }
  setSeed(seed){
    this.sa.fill(0);
    const num = seed === -2147483648 ? 2147483647 : Math.abs(seed);
    let num2 = 161803398 - num;
    this.sa[55]=num2; let num3=1;
    for(let j=1;j<55;j++){ const num4=(21*j)%55; this.sa[num4]=num3; num3=(num2-num3)|0; if(num3<0)num3+=2147483647; num2=this.sa[num4]; }
    for(let k=1;k<5;k++) for(let l=1;l<56;l++){ this.sa[l]-=this.sa[1+((l+30)%55)]; if(this.sa[l]<0)this.sa[l]+=2147483647; }
    this.inext=0;
  }
  isamp(){
    let num=this.inext+1; if(num>55)num=1;
    let num2=num+21; if(num2>55)num2-=55;
    let num3=this.sa[num]-this.sa[num2];
    if(num3===2147483647)num3--;
    num3=num3+((num3>>31)&0x7fffffff);
    this.sa[num]=num3; this.inext=num; return num3;
  }
}

  for(let k=0;k<sa.length;k++) mix(sa[k]);
  mix(inext);
  return h.toString(16).padStart(8,'0');

static string Fmt(Instruction ins) => ins.Operand switch
{
    null => "",
    Instruction t => $"IL_{t.Offset:X4}",
    MethodReference m => $"{m.DeclaringType.FullName}::{m.Name}({string.Join(",", m.Parameters.Select(p => p.ParameterType.MetadataType))})",
    FieldReference f => $"{f.DeclaringType.FullName}::{f.Name}",
    TypeReference t => t.FullName,
    _ => ins.Operand.ToString() ?? ""
};

static int? LdcVal(Mono.Cecil.Cil.Instruction i)
{
    if (i.OpCode.Code == Code.Ldc_I4) return (int)i.Operand;
    if (i.OpCode.Code == Code.Ldc_I4_S) return (sbyte)i.Operand;
    return null;
}

static TypeDefinition ImportProbeType(ModuleDefinition mod, string probeDll, string ns, string name)
{
    using var probeAsm = AssemblyDefinition.ReadAssembly(probeDll);
    var probeMod = probeAsm.MainModule;
    var srcType = probeMod.GetType(ns, name)
        ?? throw new InvalidOperationException(name + " not found in ProbeLib");
    var dstType = new TypeDefinition(srcType.Namespace, srcType.Name, srcType.Attributes, mod.TypeSystem.Object);
    foreach (var f in srcType.Fields)
        dstType.Fields.Add(new FieldDefinition(f.Name, f.Attributes, mod.ImportReference(f.FieldType)));
    foreach (var m in srcType.Methods)
    {
        var dm = new MethodDefinition(m.Name, m.Attributes, mod.ImportReference(m.ReturnType));
        foreach (var p in m.Parameters)
            dm.Parameters.Add(new ParameterDefinition(p.Name, p.Attributes, mod.ImportReference(p.ParameterType)));
        dstType.Methods.Add(dm);
    }
    foreach (var m in srcType.Methods)
        CopyBody(m, dstType.Methods.First(x => x.Name == m.Name), mod, srcType, dstType);
    mod.Types.Add(dstType);
    return dstType;
}

static void Patch(ModuleDefinition mod, MethodDefinition applyPass, string probeDll)
{
    var dstType = ImportProbeType(mod, probeDll, "Terraria.GameContent.Biomes", "TerrainProbe");
    var enterRef = dstType.Methods.First(m => m.Name == "Enter");
    var colRef = dstType.Methods.First(m => m.Name == "Col");

    var ip = applyPass.Body.GetILProcessor();
    var first = applyPass.Body.Instructions[0];
    ip.InsertBefore(first, ip.Create(OpCodes.Call, enterRef));
    Console.WriteLine("[inject] Enter() at ApplyPass entry");

    var body = applyPass.Body;
    var injected = 0;
    for (int idx = 0; idx < body.Instructions.Count; idx++)
    {
        var cur = body.Instructions[idx];
        if (cur.OpCode.Code != Code.Call || cur.Operand is not MethodReference mr || mr.Name != "FillColumn") continue;
        static bool IsLdloc(OpCode op) => op.Code is Code.Ldloc or Code.Ldloc_0 or Code.Ldloc_1 or Code.Ldloc_2 or Code.Ldloc_3 or Code.Ldloc_S;
        var push = new List<Instruction>();
        for (int k = idx - 1; k >= 0 && push.Count < 3 && IsLdloc(body.Instructions[k].OpCode); k--)
            push.Add(body.Instructions[k]);
        push.Reverse();
        if (push.Count != 3) { Console.WriteLine($"[skip] IL_{cur.Offset:X4}: 非 [ldloc x3] 形态（push={push.Count}）"); continue; }
        var slots = push.Select(p => p.Slot()).ToArray();
        Console.WriteLine($"[inject] IL_{cur.Offset:X4} <- Col(V{slots[0]}, V{slots[1]}, V{slots[2]})");
        ip.InsertBefore(cur, ip.Create(OpCodes.Ldloc, body.Variables[slots[0]]));
        ip.InsertBefore(cur, ip.Create(OpCodes.Ldloc, body.Variables[slots[1]]));
        ip.InsertBefore(cur, ip.Create(OpCodes.Ldloc, body.Variables[slots[2]]));
        ip.InsertBefore(cur, ip.Create(OpCodes.Call, colRef));
        injected++;
        idx += 4;
    }
    if (injected == 0) throw new InvalidOperationException("no FillColumn call site injected");
}

namespace Terraria;

public class LiquidBuffer
{
	public static int numLiquidBuffer;

	public int x;

	public int y;

	public static void AddBuffer(int x, int y)
	{
		if (numLiquidBuffer < 49998 && !Main.tile[x, y].checkingLiquid())
		{
			Main.tile[x, y].checkingLiquid(checkingLiquid: true);
			Main.liquidBuffer[numLiquidBuffer].x = x;
			Main.liquidBuffer[numLiquidBuffer].y = y;
			numLiquidBuffer++;
		}
	}

	public static void DelBuffer(int l)
	{
		numLiquidBuffer--;
		Main.liquidBuffer[l].x = Main.liquidBuffer[numLiquidBuffer].x;
		Main.liquidBuffer[l].y = Main.liquidBuffer[numLiquidBuffer].y;
	}
}

```

                catch (Exception e) { Mark("#dumpall-ex " + passName + " " + e.GetType().Name + ": " + e.Message); }
                return;
            }
            string cfg = Environment.GetEnvironmentVariable("SW_GRID_DUMP");
            if (cfg == null) return;
            foreach (string one in cfg.Split(','))
            {
                string[] kv = one.Split(':');
                if (kv.Length != 2 || kv[0] != passName) continue;
                try
                {
                    WriteGrid(kv[1], W, H, tile);
                    Mark("#griddump " + passName + " -> " + kv[1]);
                }
                catch (Exception e) { Mark("#griddump-ex " + passName + " " + e.GetType().Name + ": " + e.Message); }
            }
        }

 "content": "// 一次性（DD 终清）：#97 沉降中途对拍 + #98 仙人掌列级事件链对拍。\n// 真值 = /tmp/sw-ddfin/（Cecil SettleProbe/CactusProbe 注入 exe，SW_EVIL=0,种子\n// 9293480）：s97{e,qw,wc,r0,r1,f}.{liq,lty} + settle.txt + cactus.txt。\n// 本文件：同构驱动 JS LiquidSim 至同相位落盘 + FNV 对拍 + 首分叉定位。\nimport { it } from 'vitest';\nconst RUN = !!process.env.SW_PARITY;\nimport { readFileSync, writeFileSync } from 'node:fs';\nimport { generateWorld } from '../src/world/gen/WorldGen';\nimport { World } from '../src/world/World';\nimport { LiquidSim } from '../src/world/liquid/LiquidSim';\nimport { runCactusPalmTreesAndCoralPass, setCcTrace } from '../src/world/gen/vanilla/StructuresPass';\nimport { snapshotGenSolid, restoreGenSolid } from '../src/world/gen/vanilla/GenSolid';\nimport { RNG } from '../src/core/rng';\nimport { TILE_DEFS } from '../src/data/tiles';\nimport { TileStore } from '../src/world/TileStore';\nimport type { GenState } from '../src/world/gen/vanilla/GenState';\n\nconst VG = '/tmp/sw-num4/van_x86_g';\nconst DD = '/tmp/sw-ddfin';\nconst W = 4200, H = 1200;\nconst NAMES: Record<number, string> = {\n  96: 'Larva', 97: 'Settle_Liquids_Again', 98: 'Cactus__Palm_Trees____Coral',\n};\nconst load = (idx: number, ext: string) => readFileSync(`${VG}/${String(idx).padStart(3, '0')}_${NAMES[idx]}.${ext}`);\n\nconst REV = new Map<number, number>();\nconst SHEET = new Int32Array(TILE_DEFS.length).fill(-1);\nfor (let i = 0; i < TILE_DEFS.length; i++) {\n  const s = TILE_DEFS[i]?.vanilla?.sheet;\n  if (typeof s === 'number') { SHEET[i] = s; if (!REV.has(s)) REV.set(s, i); }\n}\nSHEET[0] = 0;\n\nfunction truthExtra(tag: '96' | '97'): Record<string, Uint8Array | Uint16Array> {\n  const rd = (e: string) => new Uint8Array(readFileSync(`/tmp/sw-mb-hs${tag}.${e}`).buffer.slice(0));\n  const half = rd('half'), slope = rd('slope'), lty = rd('lty'), inact = rd('inact');\n  const liq = load(tag === '97' ? 97 : 96, 'liq');\n  const ltyJ = new Uint8Array(W * H), wire = new Uint8Array(W * H);\n  for (let i = 0; i < W * H; i++) {\n    ltyJ[i] = liq[i]! > 0 ? lty[i]! + 1 : 0;\n    wire[i] = inact[i] ? 32 : 0;\n  }\n  return { half, slope, liqtype: ltyJ, wire };\n}\n\nfunction buildStore(idx: number, extra?: Record<string, Uint8Array | Uint16Array>): TileStore {\n  const t = new Uint16Array(load(idx, 'typ').buffer.slice(0));\n  const a = load(idx, 'act');\n  const w = new Uint16Array(load(idx, 'wal').buffer.slice(0));\n  const l = load(idx, 'liq');\n  const st = new TileStore(W, H);\n  for (let i = 0; i < W * H; i++) {\n    st.type[i] = REV.get(t[i]!) ?? 0;\n    st.flags[i] = a[i] ? 1 : 0;\n    st.wall[i] = w[i]!;\n    st.liquid[i] = l[i]!;\n    st.liquidType[i] = extra?.liqtype ? (extra.liqtype as Uint8Array)[i]! : (l[i]! > 0 ? 1 : 0);\n  }\n  if (extra) {\n    if (extra.slope) st.slope.set(extra.slope as Uint8Array);\n    if (extra.half) st.half.set(extra.half as Uint8Array);\n    if (extra.wire) st.wire.set(extra.wire as Uint8Array);\n  }\n  return st;\n}\n\n/** UR 状态 FNV（与 exe SettleProbe.RandFnv 同式：56×int32 LE + inext） */\nfunction urFnv(rng: RNG): string {\n  const ur = (rng as unknown as { ur: { seedArray: Int32Array; inext: number } }).ur;\n  let h = 2166136261 >>> 0;\n  const mix = (v: number) => {\n    v = v >>> 0;\n    for (let s = 0; s < 32; s += 8) { h = (h ^ ((v >>> s) & 0xff)) >>> 0; h = Math.imul(h, 16777619) >>> 0; }\n  };\n  for (let k = 0; k < ur.seedArray.length; k++) mix(ur.seedArray[k]!);\n  mix(ur.inext);\n  return h.toString(16).padStart(8, '0');\n}\n\nfunction countedRng(seed: number) {\n  const rng = new RNG(seed);\n  const ur = (rng as unknown as { ur: { internalSample: () => number } }).ur;\n  const orig = ur.internalSample.bind(ur);\n  const box = { n: 0 };\n  ur.internalSample = () => { box.n++; return orig(); };\n  return { rng, box };\n}\n\nfunction cloneGs(gs: GenState): GenState {\n  const c = { ...gs } as unknown as Record<string, unknown>;\n  for (const k of Object.keys(c)) {\n    const v = c[k];\n    if (Array.isArray(v)) c[k] = v.map((e) => (e && typeof e === 'object' ? { ...(e as object) } : e));\n    else if (v instanceof Int32Array) c[k] = v.slice();\n    else if (v instanceof Uint8Array) c[k] = v.slice();\n    else if (v instanceof Uint16Array) c[k] = v.slice();\n    else if (v && typeof v === 'object') c[k] = { ...(v as Record<string, unknown>) };\n  }\n  return c as unknown as GenState;\n}\n\n/** 两份网格逐格 diff（vanilla 为 0 基 lty，JS -1） */\nfunction diffGrids(jsLiq: Uint8Array, jsLty: Uint8Array, tag: string, maxShow = 10) {\n  const vLiq = new Uint8Array(readFileSync(`${DD}/s97${tag}.liq`).buffer.slice(0));\n  const vLty = new Uint8Array(readFileSync(`${DD}/s97.lty.${tag}`).buffer.slice(0));\n  let dl = 0, dt = 0;\n  const samples: string[] = [];\n  const regs = new Map<string, number>();\n  for (let i = 0; i < W * H; i++) {\n    const jl = jsLiq[i], jlty = (jsLty[i]! - 1) & 0xff;\n    const a = jl !== vLiq[i], b = jlty !== vLty[i];\n    if (!a && !b) continue;\n    if (a) dl++; if (b) dt++;\n    const x = i % W, y = (i / W) | 0;\n    regs.set(`x${(x / 300) | 0}y${(y / 300) | 0}`, (regs.get(`x${(x / 300) | 0}y${(y / 300) | 0}`) ?? 0) + 1);\n    if (samples.length < maxShow) samples.push(`(${x},${y})L${jl}>${vLiq[i]}T${jlty}>${vLty[i]}`);\n  }\n  console.log(`[phase ${tag}] liqDiff=${dl} ltyDiff=${dt}`);\n  console.log('  regs:', JSON.stringify([...regs.entries()].sort((p, q) => q[1] - p[1]).slice(0, 6)));\n  console.log('  samples:', samples.join(' | '));\n  return { dl, dt };\n}\n\ninterface Cap { gs: GenState; solid: Map<number, boolean> }\nlet cap: Cap | null = null;\n\n(RUN ? it : it.skip)('ddfin settle+cactus checkpoint parity', async () => {\n  // ── A) 捕获管线 gs/GenSolid（__swCcCap 钩子）──\n  if (!cap) {\n    const g0 = globalThis as { __swCcCap?: (gs: GenState, st: TileStore) => void };\n    g0.__swCcCap = (gs) => { if (!cap) cap = { gs: cloneGs(gs), solid: snapshotGenSolid() }; };\n    try { await generateWorld({ width: W, height: H, seedText: '9293480', evil: 0, onWorldPartial: () => { } }); }\n    catch (e) { console.log('pipeline EX(忽略):', String(e).slice(0, 160)); }\n    finally { g0.__swCcCap = undefined; }\n  }\n  if (!cap) throw new Error('gs capture failed');\n  console.log(`gs: ws=${cap.gs.worldSurface} waterLine=${cap.gs.waterLine} dungeonSide=${cap.gs.dungeonSide}`);\n\n  // ── B) #97：手动同构驱动至各相位，落盘 + 对拍 ──\n  const st = buildStore(96, truthExtra('96'));\n  const world = new World(W, H, cap.gs.seed);\n  world.store = st;\n  world.genWaterLine = cap.gs.waterLine;\n  if (cap.gs.dungeonSide !== 0) {\n    const edge = Math.floor(W * 0.05), mid = Math.floor(W * 0.55);\n    world.genDungeonExempt = cap.gs.dungeonSide < 0\n      ? { x0: edge, x1: Math.floor(W * 0.45), y0: Math.floor(cap.gs.worldSurface) + 10, y1: H - 200 - 10 }\n      : { x0: mid, x1: W - edge, y0: Math.floor(cap.gs.worldSurface) + 10, y1: H - 200 - 10 };\n  }\n  const { rng, box } = countedRng(cap.gs.seed);\n  const sim = new LiquidSim(world);\n  sim.isGeneratingOrLoadingWorld = true;\n  sim.generatingWorld = true;\n  sim.shimmerCenter = world.shimmerX > 0 ? { x: world.shimmerX, y: world.shimmerY } : null;\n  if (world.genWaterLine > 0) {\n    sim.genWaterLine = world.genWaterLine;\n    const d = world.genDungeonExempt;\n    if (d) sim.dungeonWaterExempt = (x, y, w) =>\n      x >= d.x0 && x <= d.x1 && y >= d.y0 && y <= d.y1\n      && (w === 7 || w === 8 || w === 9 || (w >= 94 && w <= 99));\n  }\n  sim.passRand = (max) => rng.nextInt(max);\n  const dump = (tag: string) => {\n    writeFileSync(`/tmp/sw-ddfin-js/${tag}.liq`, Buffer.from(st.liquid));\n    const lty0 = new Uint8Array(W * H);\n    for (let i = 0; i < W * H; i++) lty0[i] = (st.liquidType[i]! - 1) & 0xff;\n    writeFileSync(`/tmp/sw-ddfin-js/${tag}.lty`, Buffer.from(lty0));\n  };\n  console.log(`phase e: draws=${box.n} fnv=${urFnv(rng)}`);\n  diffGrids(st.liquid, st.liquidType, 'e');\n  sim.quickWater();\n  dump('qw');\n  console.log(`phase qw: draws=${box.n} fnv=${urFnv(rng)} nl=${sim.numLiquid} nb=${sim.bufferLen}`);\n  diffGrids(st.liquid, st.liquidType, 'qw');\n  sim.waterCheck();\n  dump('wc');\n  console.log(`phase wc: draws=${box.n} fnv=${urFnv(rng)} nl=${sim.numLiquid} nb=${sim.bufferLen}`);\n  diffGrids(st.liquid, st.liquidType, 'wc');\n  sim.quickSettle = true;\n  let ulTotal = 0;\n  for (let round = 0; round < 10; round++) {\n    let it = 0, MAX_ITER = (sim.numLiquid + sim.bufferLen) * 5;\n    while (sim.numLiquid > 0 && it < MAX_ITER) { sim.updateLiquid(); it++; }\n    ulTotal += it;\n    sim.waterCheck();\n    if (round <= 2) {\n      dump(`r${round}`);\n      console.log(`phase r${round}: ul=${it} ulTotal=${ulTotal} draws=${box.n} fnv=${urFnv(rng)} nl=${sim.numLiquid} nb=${sim.bufferLen}`);\n      diffGrids(st.liquid, st.liquidType, `r${round}`);\n    } else {\n      console.log(`phase r${round}: ul=${it} draws=${box.n} nl=${sim.numLiquid} nb=${sim.bufferLen}`);\n    }\n  }\n  sim.quickSettle = false;\n  (sim as unknown as { liquids: unknown[] }).liquids.length = 0;\n  (sim as unknown as { numLiquid: number }).numLiquid = 0;\n  dump('f');\n  console.log(`phase f: draws=${box.n} fnv=${urFnv(rng)}`);\n  diffGrids(st.liquid, st.liquidType, 'f');\n  console.log(`settle draws total=${box.n} (vanilla 55987, diff=${box.n - 55987})`);\n  sim.dispose();\n\n  // 与 dump097（pass 末真值）总量对拍\n  const l97 = load(97, 'liq');\n  let dl97 = 0;\n  for (let i = 0; i < W * H; i++) if (st.liquid[i] !== l97[i]) dl97++;\n  console.log(`f vs dump097 liqDiff=${dl97}`);\n\n  // ── C) #98：仙人掌列级事件链对拍 ──\n  const st2 = buildStore(97, truthExtra('97'));\n  const world2 = new World(W, H, cap.gs.seed);\n  world2.store = st2;\n  const { rng: rng2, box: box2 } = countedRng(cap.gs.seed);\n  restoreGenSolid(cap.solid);\n  const events: string[] = [];\n  setCcTrace({\n    plant: (i, j) => events.push(`P ${i} ${j} ${urFnv(rng2)}`),\n    kill: (i, j) => events.push(`K ${i} ${j}`),\n  });\n  runCactusPalmTreesAndCoralPass(st2, rng2, cap.gs);\n  setCcTrace(null);\n  console.log(`cc draws=${box2.n} (vanilla 1268797, diff=${box2.n - 1268797}) events=${events.filter((e) => e[0] === 'P').length}P`);\n  const jsLines = events;\n  const vanLines = readFileSync(`${DD}/cactus.txt`, 'utf8').split('\\n').filter((l) => l.startsWith('P ') || l.startsWith('K '));\n  writeFileSync('/tmp/sw-ddfin-js/cactus-js.txt', jsLines.join('\\n') + '\\n');\n  let firstMis = -1;\n  const n = Math.min(jsLines.length, vanLines.length);\n  for (let k = 0; k < n; k++) {\n    const a = jsLines[k]!.split(' '), b = vanLines[k]!.split(' ');\n    if (a[0] !== b[0] || a[1] !== b[1] || a[2] !== b[2]) { firstMis = k; break; }\n  }\n  console.log(`event chain: js=${jsLines.length} van=${vanLines.length} firstMismatch=${firstMis}`);\n  if (firstMis >= 0) {\n    for (let k = Math.max(0, firstMis - 3); k < Math.min(n, firstMis + 6); k++) {\n      const mark = k === firstMis ? '>>' : '  ';\n      console.log(`${mark}[${k}] js=${jsLines[k]} van=${vanLines[k]}`);\n    }\n  }\n}, 480000);\n"
}

// 液体沉降黄金回归(2026-08-13 性能优化①buffer 头指针队列+②实心 LUT 的等价性闸门):
// 自包含合成夹具(确定性、无 /tmp 依赖)→ settleWorldLiquids('gen') → 四数组哈希对 golden。
// golden 取自"与优化前代码逐字节一致"的输出(冻结快照 A/B 验证,见会话记录);
// 此后任何 LiquidSim 改动破坏该哈希即被本测试拦截。
import { describe, it, expect } from 'vitest';
import { World } from '../src/world/World';
import { settleWorldLiquids } from '../src/world/liquid/settle';

function fnv1a(u8: Uint8Array): string {
  let h = 0x811c9dc5;
  for (let i = 0; i < u8.length; i++) { h ^= u8[i]; h = Math.imul(h, 0x01000193); }
  return (h >>> 0).toString(16).padStart(8, '0');
}

function fixture(): World {
  // 220×260 合成世界:基岩地板+若干岩腔,灌水/岩浆/蜂蜜/微光四类液体
  const w = 220, h = 260;
  const world = new World(w, h, 424242, 'golden');
  world.groundLevel = 60; world.rockLevel = 110; world.lavaLine = h - 40;
  const st = world.store;
  const STONE = 2, DIRT = 1;
  for (let x = 0; x < w; x++) {
    for (let y = h - 20; y < h; y++) { st.type[st.idx(x, y)] = STONE; st.flags[st.idx(x, y)] = 1; }
  }
  const cavity = (x0: number, y0: number, cw: number, ch: number) => {
    for (let x = x0; x < x0 + cw; x++) for (let y = y0; y < y0 + ch; y++) {
      const i = st.idx(x, y);
      st.type[i] = 0; st.flags[i] = 0; st.wall[i] = 0;
    }
  };
  const fill = (x0: number, y0: number, cw: number, ch: number, amt: number, type: number) => {
    for (let x = x0; x < x0 + cw; x++) for (let y = y0; y < y0 + ch; y++) {
      const i = st.idx(x, y);
      st.liquid[i] = amt; st.liquidType[i] = type;
    }
  };
  cavity(20, 150, 60, 30);  fill(24, 154, 50, 20, 255, 1);      // 水池(悬空 4 格待沉降)
  cavity(100, 150, 50, 40); fill(104, 170, 40, 10, 255, 2);     // 岩浆湖(上有水滴)
  fill(110, 154, 10, 8, 200, 1);
  cavity(160, 120, 40, 60); fill(164, 160, 30, 15, 255, 3);     // 蜂蜜池+接触水
  fill(170, 140, 8, 6, 180, 1);
  cavity(30, 40, 80, 50);  fill(40, 44, 60, 30, 255, 1);        // 地表湖(带土墙)
  for (let x = 30; x < 110; x++) for (let y = 40; y < 90; y++) if (!st.flags[st.idx(x, y)]) st.wall[st.idx(x, y)] = 2;
  // 微光腔(触发 ShimmerRemoveWater 路径)
  world.shimmerX = 170; world.shimmerY = 190;
  cavity(160, 180, 30, 20); fill(164, 184, 20, 10, 255, 4);
  fill(200, 60, 12, 8, 255, 1);                                  // 微光腔附近的一汪水(应被脱水)
  return world;
}

describe('液体沉降 golden(优化等价性闸门)', () => {
  it('合成四类液体夹具:哈希恒定', async () => {
    const world = fixture();
    await settleWorldLiquids(world, 'gen');
    const st = world.store;
    const hash = [st.liquid, st.liquidType, st.type, st.flags].map((a) =>
      fnv1a(new Uint8Array(a.buffer, a.byteOffset, a.byteLength))).join(' ');
    expect(hash).toBe('f4f6614e d6806ecf b6f70ec5 e84ee6b5');   // golden(与优化前逐字节一致,冻结快照 A/B 验证)
  }, 120000);
});

```

	private static void addSubTile(params int[] styles)
	{
		newSubTile.Calculate();
		foreach (int num in styles)
		{
			List<TileObjectData> list;
			if (!newTile._hasOwnSubTiles)
			{
				list = new List<TileObjectData>(num + 1);
				newTile.SubTiles = list;
			}
			else
			{
				list = newTile.SubTiles;
			}
			if (list.Count <= num)
			{
				for (int j = list.Count; j <= num; j++)
				{
					list.Add(null);
				}
			}
			newSubTile._parent = newTile;
			list[num] = newSubTile;
		}
		newSubTile = new TileObjectData(_baseObject);
	}

			List<TileObjectData> list;
			if (!newTile._hasOwnSubTiles)

				list = new List<TileObjectData>(num + 1);
				newTile.SubTiles = list;
